audits.numeric_policy: No explicit 2024 Air annual-mass Pollution Inventory substance row was retrieved for any of the five facilities, therefore no numeric candidate is created.

audits.direct_raw_policy: No new direct-resource fetch attempt was made after the bounded Part110 transport failure; repeated failed-route loops are avoided.
audits.zero_policy: Missing or unretrieved annual mass remains no-data and is never represented as zero.
